settings.language_description.en: Changes apply immediately to all windows and menus.
settings.language_description.zh-CN: 切换后立即应用于所有窗口和菜单。

settings.make_beacon_feel_at_home.zh-CN: 调整 Beacon 的外观与语言。

settings.choose_how_cluster_contexts_app.en: Choose how cluster contexts appear in the sidebar.
settings.choose_how_cluster_contexts_app.zh-CN: 设置侧边栏中集群上下文的显示方式。

settings.choose_a_base_make_it_yours_the.en: Choose a base, make it yours, then save and apply.
settings.choose_a_base_make_it_yours_the.zh-CN: 选择基础主题，调整后保存并应用。

settings.choose_how_beacon_connects_to_c.en: Choose how Beacon connects to clusters and checks for updates.
settings.choose_how_beacon_connects_to_c.zh-CN: 设置集群连接和更新检查使用的代理。

settings.manage_your_version_and_update_.en: Manage your version and update preferences.
settings.manage_your_version_and_update_.zh-CN: 管理应用版本和更新偏好。

settings.manage_where_your_available_clu.en: Manage where your available clusters come from.

settings.give_this_cluster_a_familiar_na.en: Give this cluster a familiar name and icon.
settings.give_this_cluster_a_familiar_na.zh-CN: 为集群设置别名和图标。

settings.configure_the_proxy_used_when_c.en: Configure the proxy used when connecting to this cluster.
settings.configure_the_proxy_used_when_c.zh-CN: 设置连接此集群时使用的代理。

settings.choose_where_pod_and_node_usage.en: Choose where pod and node usage metrics come from.
settings.choose_where_pod_and_node_usage.zh-CN: 选择 Pod 和节点使用量指标的来源。

settings.choose_which_fields_start_colla.en: Choose which fields start collapsed when opening a resource.
settings.choose_which_fields_start_colla.zh-CN: 设置打开资源时默认折叠的字段。

settings.theme_changes_apply_across_beac.en: Theme changes apply across Beacon windows after saving.
settings.theme_changes_apply_across_beac.zh-CN: 保存后主题会应用于所有 Beacon 窗口。

settings.choose_an_installed_font_sizes_.en: Choose an installed font. Sizes are in pixels (10–30).
settings.choose_an_installed_font_sizes_.zh-CN: 选择已安装的字体，字号单位为像素（10–30）。

settings.other_settings_have_unsaved_cha.zh-CN: 其他设置有未保存的更改

settings.preview_only_apply_to_use_this_.en: Preview only · Apply to use this theme across all windows
settings.preview_only_apply_to_use_this_.zh-CN: 仅预览 · 应用后将用于所有窗口

settings.changes_apply_across_all_window.en: Changes apply across all windows after saving
settings.changes_apply_across_all_window.zh-CN: 保存后应用于所有窗口

settings.changes_apply_across_cluster_vi.en: Changes apply across cluster views after saving
settings.changes_apply_across_cluster_vi.zh-CN: 保存后应用于此集群的所有视图

settings.connection_changes_require_a_re.zh-CN: 连接设置更改需要重新连接

settings.source_changes_save_automatical.en: Source changes save automatically · Connections stay open
settings.source_changes_save_automatical.zh-CN: 来源更改会自动保存 · 保持现有连接

settings.folding_applies_the_next_time_a.en: Folding applies the next time a resource opens
settings.folding_applies_the_next_time_a.zh-CN: 下次打开资源时应用折叠设置

settings.a_url_with_a_base_path_is_suppo.en: A URL with a base path is supported.
settings.a_url_with_a_base_path_is_suppo.zh-CN: 支持包含基础路径的地址。

settings.all_color_options_search_by_com.en: All color options. Search by component, such as button or sidebar.
settings.all_color_options_search_by_com.zh-CN: 全部颜色选项，可按 button、sidebar 等组件名称搜索。

settings.choose_how_you_distinguish_cont.en: Choose how you distinguish contexts from different kubeconfig sources.
settings.choose_how_you_distinguish_cont.zh-CN: 设置如何区分来自不同 Kubeconfig 来源的上下文。

settings.click_a_color_to_choose_from_th.en: Click a color to choose from the palette or enter a hex value. The preview updates immediately.
settings.click_a_color_to_choose_from_th.zh-CN: 点击颜色选择色板或输入十六进制颜色，预览会立即更新。

settings.file_names_distinguish_matching.en: File names distinguish matching contexts from the same folder. Hover a context to see its full origin.
settings.file_names_distinguish_matching.zh-CN: 文件名用于区分同一文件夹中的同名上下文，悬停可查看完整来源。

settings.hex_value_leave_empty_to_inheri.en: Hex value · Leave empty to inherit
settings.hex_value_leave_empty_to_inheri.zh-CN: 十六进制颜色 · 留空以继承

settings.no_overrides_yet_all_colors_inh.en: No overrides yet. All colors inherit from the base theme.
settings.no_overrides_yet_all_colors_inh.zh-CN: 暂无自定义颜色，全部颜色继承自基础主题。

settings.queries_return_cpu_in_cores_and.en: Queries return CPU in cores and memory in bytes. Pod results require namespace/pod labels; node results require a node label; container results require namespace/pod/container labels. Add cluster selectors when Prometheus contains multiple clusters.
settings.queries_return_cpu_in_cores_and.zh-CN: 查询应返回以核为单位的 CPU 和以字节为单位的内存。Pod 结果需要 namespace/pod 标签，节点结果需要 node 标签，容器结果需要 namespace/pod/container 标签。Prometheus 包含多个集群时请添加集群选择条件。

settings.socks5_cannot_carry_kubectl_s_s.en: SOCKS5 cannot carry kubectl's SPDY Shell/Exec fallback. Use HTTP or HTTPS when that compatibility path is needed.
settings.socks5_cannot_carry_kubectl_s_s.zh-CN: SOCKS5 无法承载 kubectl 的 SPDY Shell/Exec 回退连接，需要此兼容方式时请使用 HTTP 或 HTTPS。

settings.source_indicators_appear_when_c.en: Source indicators appear when contexts come from more than one source.
settings.source_indicators_appear_when_c.zh-CN: 存在多个上下文来源时显示来源标识。

settings.this_installation_is_managed_ex.en: This installation is managed externally. Install the downloaded package with your package manager. Automatic installation is available for macOS/Windows apps and Linux AppImage.
settings.this_installation_is_managed_ex.zh-CN: 此安装由外部工具管理，请使用包管理器安装下载的更新包。macOS、Windows 应用和 Linux AppImage 支持自动安装。

settings.use_dot_separated_paths_such_as.en: Use dot-separated paths, such as metadata.annotations or spec.template.spec.containers. Paths below a list apply to every item.
settings.use_dot_separated_paths_such_as.zh-CN: 使用点分隔字段路径，如 metadata.annotations 或 spec.template.spec.containers；列表下的路径会应用于每个元素。

settings.used_in_the_sidebar_tabs_and_st.en: Used in the sidebar, tabs and status bar. Leave empty to use the kubeconfig name.
settings.used_in_the_sidebar_tabs_and_st.zh-CN: 用于侧边栏、标签页和状态栏。留空时使用 Kubeconfig 中的名称。

settings.uses_metrics_k8s_io_clusters_wi.en: Uses metrics.k8s.io. Clusters without metrics-server show no CPU or memory samples.
settings.uses_metrics_k8s_io_clusters_wi.zh-CN: 使用 metrics.k8s.io，未安装 metrics-server 的集群无法显示 CPU 或内存采样。

settings.update_state_4.zh-CN: 下载期间可以继续使用 Beacon。

settings.update_state_7.en: Keep Beacon open while the installer is prepared.
settings.update_state_7.zh-CN: 准备安装程序期间请保持 Beacon 运行。

settings.update_state_11.en: Check your network connection and try again.
settings.update_state_11.zh-CN: 请检查网络连接后重试。

updates.verified.en: Beacon %{version} is verified and ready to install after restart.
updates.verified.zh-CN: Beacon %{version} 已通过验证，可在重启后安装。

updates.channel_latest.en: Find the latest release on the %{channel} channel.
